name: Teach the World Foundation
mission: To eradicate illiteracy by providing digital learning tools, training teachers and community leaders, and creating scalable, sustainable digital education programs for underserved children.
theoryOfChange: Teach the World aims to solve the world's illiteracy problem through programs that leverage digital learning and encourage self-learning.  Our method is rapidly deployable, cost-effective, and outperforms the traditional system.  Our strategy is to start with out-of-school children in targeted communities and them expand across the globe, and literally Teach the World.

strengths_deep_dive: While limiting factors impact the foundation's overall efficiency, its core program design achieves documented learning gains. Through tablet-based digital learning models, participants demonstrated improved foundational reading and math skills, with an <cite id="4">Outcome Harvesting Report showing improved literacy and confidence</cite> in targeted regions.
rich_narrative.summary: Teach the World Foundation faces significant financial operational constraints, as reflected by a program expense ratio of <cite id="1">78.0% in FY2024</cite>, which falls well below the 75% industry standard and peer median of <cite id="9">89.5%</cite>. Operating on <cite id="1">$363,707 in total revenue</cite>, the organization maintains lean financial reserves covering only <cite id="9">1.5 months of working capital</cite> and displays governance limitations with minimal board size. Despite these structural challenges, the foundation utilizes scalable digital tools and MicroSchools to deliver basic education. Independent evaluations demonstrate <cite id="4">verified literacy and numeracy gains</cite> at a low cost of <cite id="4">$7.10 per beneficiary</cite> across operations in Pakistan, Malawi, and Bangladesh.
